name: software-mansion/TypeGPU
description: Modular WebGPU toolkit with advanced TypeScript type inference, allowing developers to write GPU shaders directly in TypeScript with automatic WGSL generation and type-safe buffer management.
score_rationale: Innovative TypeScript-first WebGPU toolkit with 2.3k stars, recently released (v0.10 in 2026) and filling a unique niche for type-safe GPU programming on the web.
summary: TypeScript-first WebGPU toolkit with type-safe shaders
